title: LLM-based User-Product Relevance Evaluation for Dynamic Product Advertising
abstract: arXiv:2610.14550v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Dynamic Product Advertising (DPA) retrieval systems are a core component of modern e-commerce advertising; however, their evaluation remains challenging. Conventional offline engagement metrics are limited by sparse, biased feedback, while online evaluation is costly and time-consuming. In this work, we propose a user--product relevance metric for offline evaluation of DPA retrieval systems. The metric first compresses the engagement history into a compact set of intent representatives via Semantic-ID-grouped, event-stratified segmentation, then assesses the relevance of a recommended product to each individual intent and aggregates them as a user-level relevance score, yielding a stable and interpretable measure of retrieval quality. To compute this metric at scale, we leverage large language models (LLMs) as semantic relevance judges, capturing nuanced functional and semantic relationships that heuristic methods often miss. translated_title: 基于大语言模型的动态产品广告用户-产品相关性评估
translated_abstract: 动态产品广告（DPA）检索系统是现代电商广告的核心组成部分，然而其评估仍然充满挑战。传统的线下互动指标受到稀疏且有偏反馈的限制，而线上评估则成本高昂且耗时。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种用于DPA检索系统离线评估的用户-产品相关性指标。该指标首先通过基于语义ID分组、事件分层的划分方法，将用户互动历史压缩为一组紧凑的意图代表，然后评估推荐产品与每个独立意图的相关性，并将其聚合为用户级别的相关性分数，从而得到一种稳定且可解释的检索质量度量。为了大规模计算该指标，我们利用大语言模型（LLM）作为语义相关性评判者，捕捉启发式方法经常遗漏的细微功能和语义关系。我们提出……
tldr: 提出了一种基于大语言模型的用户-产品相关性评估指标，通过将用户互动历史压缩为意图代表并聚合相关性分数，为动态产品广告检索系统提供了稳定、可解释且可大规模计算的离线评估方法。
en_tdlr: Proposes an LLM-based user-product relevance metric that compresses engagement history into intent representatives and aggregates relevance scores, enabling stable, interpretable, and scalable offline evaluation for Dynamic Product Advertising retrieval systems.
